instruction: You're starting in an empty closet, facing a bathroom. Walk straight ahead to the open door on the right to exit the bathroom. It's at the end of this long, dark counter. Head into the bedroom, and then immediately exit the bedroom through the door on the right into the hallway. Go straight down the hallway. You'll pass the stairs, as well as the black and white photos on the right hand side. You'll now be at the very back of the hall. You'll see some more black and white framed photos on the wall, but it's on the left hand side now. Continue straight down the hall into a bedroom with a gray rug and a white blanket at the end of the bed. Continue straight and stand between the piece of white furniture with the mirror over it and the sliding glass door. This is your destination.
